text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Rice Shower by the
Three
Goddesses statue, staring into the
fountain.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I heard that if you pray to the
Goddesses and toss
a coin into the
fountain, they'll make your wish
come
true.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
And... I want to become someone who
can bring
happiness to everyone around
me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
That's such a big thing to ask for,
though... so I
wasn't sure how many coins
to toss.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll try to squeeze all my thoughts
into it.
choice_data_list: 1コインに気持ちを込めよう
ほどほどがちょうどいいかも？

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Three Goddesses... Please make my
wish
come true!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, guess what! I didn't bring
misfortune
to anyone today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, guess what! I didn't bring
misfortune to
anyone today!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Nothing went wrong, and everyone had
a nice,
happy day.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I hope so... It feels like they did, at least.
choice_data_list: ライスの祈りが届いたんだよ

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? The fountain stopped...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll try to squeeze all my thoughts
into
them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Three Goddesses... Please make my
wish
come true!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wait, is this—we got a winning popsicle
stick!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Big Brother? Would you eat the
winning one?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Big Sister? Would you eat the
winning one?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want to give this good luck to
you... and
make you happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I want to give this good luck to
you... and
make you happy.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... The Goddesses must have
granted my
wish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? The fountain stopped...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Okay! I'll try to squeeze all my thoughts
into
them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Three Goddesses... Please make my
wish
come true!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Eep! I'm so sorry! I didn't mean to knock
into
you...

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text: Y-You're a life-saver!

text_block_list.name: Lady A
text_block_list.text:
That car there just ran a red. If you
hadn't pushed
me off the crosswalk, it
would've hit me... Thank
you so much!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? I... I did something good?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Three Goddesses... Thank you for
granting
my wish.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? The fountain stopped...

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, there's a coin blocking the
drainpipe. I
guess there must've been a
lot of students
offering prayers, huh? Oh
well, it was overdue for
a cleaning
anyway.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Oh no... This is all my fault.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
No! It's always my fault when something
goes
wrong! Always...
choice_data_list: そうと決まったわけじゃないよ

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, Mr. Janitor! I'll help clean the
fountain!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother... Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister... Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Janitor
text_block_list.text:
Whew! Thanks, you two. We got that
done
lightning fast!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
M-me? But it's my fault it was clogged in
the first
place...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm just glad we were able to get it
cleaned up...
